feeds.title: The Winding Willows Blog
feeds.description: A blog for women that supports home, health, and happiness when life has curves. Come read about being a step mom or a woman with Fibromyalgia.

feeds.title: Blended Family Hell on Earth
feeds.description: We are the modern day Brady Bunch. We met and married in 2010 when our children were ages 5, 8, 10, 12, 15 and 18 and we have been riding this rollercoaster called life or blended family life ever since. Like many families, we are living a whirlwind life juggling to balance marriage, careers, child raising, homework. Let's not do it alone. Let's learn how to walk on hot coals baby.

feeds.title: Blended Family Frappe Blog
feeds.description: A blog for stepmoms & stepdads who are in high conflict & struggling to find their way when blending feels impossible. The author is a stepmom and her goal is to carve out a little corner of calm amid all that chaos.

feeds.title: Stepmom Wisdom Blog
feeds.description: Claudette shares 30 years of wisdom & advice in her blog posts on being a stepmom, relationship challenges with stepkids, exes & life.

feeds.title: Nacho Kids Blog
feeds.description: Nacho Kids is dedicated to helping blended families thrive.

feeds.title: Raising Flowers & Skids
feeds.description: I am a Mom, Stepmom and wife who by day also doubles as a Speech Language Pathologist in private practice. I started this blog because I want to document our journey as a family as we grow, change and continue to 'blend' into our blended family. This is the place where I share the amazing adventures of raising my flowers and skids.

feeds.title: Stepmomming Blog
feeds.description: Hey there, I'm Kristen! I'm a proud stepmom of Krista and madly in love wife of Kevin currently situated near Dallas, Texas!. I developed a new vision for this blog: a safe place for stepmoms. A place where I can provide comfort and guidance for overwhelmed stepmoms, encouraging and helping them to write their own happily ever afters.

feeds.title: Ella's Blended Family
feeds.description: The blogs focus on adventures, activities, and ways to simplify our busy life as a large, blended family. Knowing that more than 70% of Blended family fail and 1300 stepfamilies are form everyday in the US alone, my goal is to give tips, tools and inspire other blended families to help them create a happy and healthy family.

feeds.title: Blended and Black Blog
feeds.description: Blended and Black is dedicated to promoting harmony and balance in mending, broken and blended millennial families. Our mission is to remove the stigma surrounding Step families while helping members redefine their roles and adjust to their new normal.

feeds.title: Real Life Leading Blog
feeds.description: Real Life Leading is all about servant leadership applied to different areas of life. Specifically, Joel is a teacher and coach who works with blended families and co-parents to help them learn to collaborate in a more positive way. Come check out the website for videos, blog posts, and other great information about making your blended family better. Also, be sure to sign up for the email newsletter and receive a FREE copy of Joel's Amazon #1 e-book (Extra)Ordinary Leadership.

feeds.title: Blended Blessings
feeds.description: Life with a blended family of 8.

feeds.title: Gayla Grace Blog
feeds.description: I'm a wife to one great guy, mom and stepmom to five children I love dearly, and owner of a beautiful- but obnoxious cat, Trixie. My husband, Randy, and I have been married more than twenty years with kids ranging from 16-32 years old in a 'his, hers, and ours' family. Here I will be Providing practical faith-based solutions for the stepparenting journey.

feeds.title: Suddenly Stepmom
feeds.description: A blog by a Yorkshire lass living in Scotland who became a sudden full-time step-mum when she married a gorgeous African man who used to have a pet baboon.

feeds.title: Stepcoupling Blog
feeds.description: Inspired by my own experiences, and the experiences of the stepfamilies I work with, I write about the stresses of day to day challenges in step families and provide simple solutions to help you sort out the mess.

feeds.title: One Blended Bunch
feeds.description: We are a blended family of 7! We blog, and vlog about the daily happening of our beautiful family... the good, the occasional bad, and the almost always funny!

feeds.title: Anna de Acosta Blog
feeds.description: A Blog about being a stepmom, growth that begins from within and radiates outward into your blended family. Mindful Stepmom, teaching practical mindfulness and everyday practices to increase peace and flow in your role as a stepmom.

feeds.title: The Blended Family Mom
feeds.description: I am a Christian women's author, speaker and mentor, and blended family mom. Married since 2004, my husband and I have four children and four grandchildren. I am also co-founder of Carpenters for Christ (carpentersforchrist.net), a Christian ministry dedicated to coaching married couples and families.

feeds.title: Wifommy
feeds.description: My pseudo name is Xara Lee. I'm a married, African-American, stay-at-home mother. This blog is a place to ask questions, get suggestions, and hear Biblical truths for you Bonus Mom. Go with God!

feeds.title: The Evil Stepmother Speaks Blog
feeds.description: Barb Goldberg was a single mom of one before she became a stepmom of three (and supermom of four). She is an accomplished businessperson and life coach and approaches stepmom life with fearlessness and a sense of humor. She wears her 'wicked' stepmom label with pride. Barb blogs about balance in stepfamilies & the importance of trust in familial harmony.

feeds.title: The Wonderful Life of a Step Mom
feeds.description: I'm a freelance writer that has three step daughters that are the light of my life. Even if that light is a train coming at my face 🙂 I enjoy helping other parents deal with their own threenagers and nonsense in their home! I offer support and solidarity that you are NOT alone! Enjoy reading about my crazy step mama life full of love and caffeine! The love of a step mother is special because they chose to love whe

feeds.title: Families Unbroken
feeds.description: Families Unbroken looks beyond stepmoms. They offer advice for blended families, stepparents, and single parents alike. Donna Mott, the blog's creator, speaks from the perspective that all stepfamilies start out broken. With guidance from her spiritual faith, Donna's mission is to help blended families like hers identify their rough edges and heal together.

feeds.title: Family [Re]Design | Blending & Single Parent Family Ministry
feeds.description: Co-founders Ken and Teri Ussery have lived the challenges of death, divorce, step-parenting, and parenting prodigals. Their desire is to use their experience, knowledge, skills and education in a ministry to offer a new perspective for divorce, remarriage, and blending families. Family [re]design gives support and encouragement to single parent homes and blending families.

feeds.title: The Calling of a Step-Mom
feeds.description: I am inspired by grace, laughter, hope, philosophy, and religious studies.

feeds.title: Better Than Blended
feeds.description: Together, Willie and Rachel Scott are the founders of Better Than Blended. A ministry that is dedicated to building blended families that thrive. As children Willie and Rachel both experienced life in a blended family home. When Willie and Rachel joined together in marriage they both desired for their children to have a different experience than what they had themselves.

feeds.title: StepParentMagazine
feeds.description: A Step Parent Magazine full of advice, tips, stories, and resources for stepparents everywhere.

feeds.title: Support for Stepdads
feeds.description: This is a website that specifically addresses all the unique experiences, struggles and challenges that come with being a stepdad. If you're a stepdad you probably already know what I'm talking about! Our site provides resources to help you be a great stepdad and a successful leader of your blended family.

feeds.title: FamilyLife » Blended Family
feeds.description: FamilyLife Blended provides biblically-based resources that help prevent re-divorce, strengthen stepfamilies, and help break the generational cycle of divorce.

feeds.title: Lights, Camera, Family
feeds.description: I'm an Actor|Mama|StepMama living in North Carolina with my beautifully blended family (two actors and our four dramatic kids). Join me as I share a 'blend' of favorite goodies, local spotlights, family adventures and travels, and few insights I've gained while parenting, co-parenting and stepparenting.

feeds.title: Bonus Families
feeds.description: Bonus Families, as an organization was founded in 1999, but the ground work was laid years before. The founder, Dr. Jann Blackstone, a divorce and stepfamily mediator, had weathered the ups and downs of co-parenting children after divorce for ten years before she felt qualified to form an organization to help others.

feeds.title: The Childless Stepmom | An Advocate For Wisdom & Growth
feeds.description: First you need to know that The Childless Stepmom is ME, not my purpose. I seek to reach all members in a blended family. Here's why. I originally created the 'The Childless Stepmom' community to reach a little known sector of women who desperately could use the support - the childless stepmoms.

feeds.title: Stepmum In Stilettos
feeds.description: A stepmother blogger, blogging for you. I am your cheerleader, your tough-lover, the one who will hold your hand or your hair back, and I know the insecurities you feel on a daily basis because I feel them too. I'm here in my best shoes and most wicked of smiles. Supporting stepmothers through anonymous blogging. Commenting on stepmothers' problems, step parents' rights, the stepmum's role and place in her stepfamily.

feeds.title: Blended Together Forever Blog
feeds.description: Blended Togather Forever,founded by Craig and Gina Morgan, is a ministry that exists to offer hope, encouragement, and resources to blended families.

feeds.title: SoS Blog | Stepmom Sanity
feeds.description: Stepmom Sanity, a national, faith-based, community. A place for stepmoms to connect with, encourage, and support each other. Here, you will be inspired and equipped to overcome struggles common to step-mothering and become the best 'other' mom you can be.

feeds.title: Stepfamily Blended Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Steph. A Wife in her Second Life. Re-Marriage and Blending a Family was not in my original plan. My eighteen year old son dying by Suicide was never dreamed. The disease Depression and Anxiety were the robbers that stole his life even before he took his own a spring day not so long ago.
